basics.name: Yoojin Choi
basics.title: Digital Product & Experience Leader
basics.tagline: Designing from the surface to the core
basics.oneLiner: I run the room, map the paths, and ship.
basics.summary: Design Lead at BCG Design Studios. Full-stack UX designer focused on the upstream of design — problem definition and solution validation. I lead a small, hands-on squad end-to-end: framing the problem, mapping journeys, prototyping, and shipping MVPs, keeping close to both users and delivery.

pillars.title: UX Expert
pillars.description: Full-stack UX designer with a focus on the upstream of design — problem definition and solution validation. Having participated in numerous product development projects, I can coordinate the project and act as a facilitator of meetings, research activities, and brainstorming sessions.

pillars.title: Communicator and Leader
pillars.description: Across a wide spectrum of projects I gained a flexible mind and the know-how to advocate the UX standpoint with stakeholders. I collaborate at ease with developers and managers, and have coached junior designers, led projects, and provided consultancy and critiques.

pillars.title: Just Make It
pillars.description: Turning ideas into something tangible is where I thrive. I prototype to think — from paper sketches to high-fidelity flows, and increasingly to working software built with AI. Vibe-coding lets me turn a concept into a functional prototype of a product, workflow, or tool in hours, so it can be tested for real instead of described. I pick up new tools fast and enjoy it.

work.summary: I lead a small, hands-on design squad. We work end-to-end: framing the problem, mapping journeys, prototyping, and shipping MVPs. I keep us close to users and close to delivery.
highlights: Lead a cross-functional squad delivering strategy, journeys, prototypes, and MVPs.
Structured a GenAI-powered construction dashboard; simplified data views and oversight.
Led e-commerce UX review; clarified discovery and checkout flows.
Ran FI design sprints; improved internal tool usability and UI patterns.
Designed a construction MVP (tasks, risk, cost) and a starter design system.
Use DVF (Desirability, Viability, Feasibility) to make trade-offs visible and decisions faster.
Partner with marketing on campaigns that support adoption.

work.summary: As a UX specialist, my core job was providing UX consultancy for digital and electronic products of globally renowned developers and manufacturers, as well as those with high potential. The main goal was promoting UX best practices and nurturing the ecosystem of the digital space.
highlights: UX consultancy for digital/electronic products.
Project coordination and stakeholder communication across development, business development, and operations.

work.summary: Worked on various projects developing mobile and web applications, spanning from defining user flows and running ideation sessions to developing design systems and creating interactive prototypes. The latest project was a consumer app for a construction company, integrating complex infrastructural systems and IoT technology to meet the needs of prospective and current tenants.
highlights: UX/UI design for mobile and web apps.
Defined user flows, ran ideation sessions, built design systems and interactive prototypes.
Regularly participated in and facilitated UX meet-ups, bootcamps, and design contests.

work.summary: Joined the brand design team as an intern with end-to-end experience from concept development and prototyping to production-ready delivery. Later moved to the Product Planning Team and Design Lab, focusing on research and planning — qualitative research, prototyping, and testing.

subRoles.title: Product Planning Team & Design Lab
highlights: Qualitative research: user research, interviewing, stakeholder mapping
Quantitative research: surveying, analytics
Design research & product planning
Production supervision

subRoles.title: Brand & Packaging Design Team
highlights: A to Z design: sketch, lo-fi/hi-fi prototypes, production-ready design
Design research and ideation
Package design & development

work.summary: As a member of KDM, collaborated with designers and non-designers from various domains.
highlights: Industrial-academic project with LG Electronics.
Design workshop with Seymourpowell — served as workshop director.
Design exhibition at the 2015 Korea Design Festival.

education.degree: Bachelor of Arts + Bachelor of Science

coursework.graduationWork: Web Service Design for future and beginning farmers

education.area: UX Design, Design Thinking, Human-Computer Interaction

volunteerAndOther.summary: Bridged linguistic and cultural gaps for users facing new environments and facilitated seamless communication across contexts such as ERP systems, negotiations, and conferences.

recommendations.name: HyunJeong Lee (LJ)
recommendations.title: Partner Success @ Aptos Labs | Ex-Google, Ex-Microsoft
recommendations.relationship: Worked with Yoojin on the same team
recommendations.text: Yoojin is a great collaborator and a trusted person when you need a POV on UX across various platforms from app to web. I had a great pleasure working with Yoojin to close several key deals, and Yoojin always managed to provide his work and proactively shared his view on solutions to close deals with speed and efficiency.
